question: A solution of the weak acid HA of pKa = 5.0 and buffered to a pH value of 7.0 has:

options.opa: An acid concentration that is 100 times greater than that of conjugate base.
options.opb: A base concentration that is 100 times greater than that of conjugate acid.
options.opc: A base concentration that is 2 times higher than that of conjugate acid.
options.opd: An acid concentration that is 2 times higher than the conjugate base.
